# AgentReady

AgentReady helps businesses assess public readiness for AI-mediated discovery, trust, agent access, and commerce.

## Product
- Free Agent Readiness Snapshot: passive, authorized checks of public website signals. No login, active vulnerability testing, port scanning, form submission, or production changes.
- Readiness Review: proposed $149 one-time pilot, delivered with human review and a practical action plan.
- Monitoring: proposed $49/month future plan; not available until customer accounts, persistent monitoring, and alerts are implemented.

Scores are directional indicators, not security certifications, search rankings, financial advice, or outcome guarantees. A missing signal is not proof of a vulnerability.

## Interfaces
- Landing page: /
- Snapshot API: POST /api/snapshot with {"url":"https://example.com","consent":true}
- Health: /health
- Proof API descriptor: /.well-known/agent-proof.json
- A2A Agent Card: /.well-known/agent-card.json

## Safety
No autonomous outreach, account access, production changes, payment processing, trading, or transactions are enabled. Human approval is required for consequential actions.
